main_text.head: LXX. ELECTORI SAXONIÆ.
Illustrissime & Clementissime Princeps.
main_text.p: 13. JUssi scribebam Caffellis ad Celsitudinem V. me brevi reversurum ad Regem Navarrenum; eo quod ab ipso accitus essem, Protraxi autem discessum meum ut responsum Celsitudinis V. jam diu a me expectatum, mecum afferrem. Sed non sine dolore experior, hanc quoque moram spei & expectationi meæ satisfacere non potuisse. Et arbitrabar certe magnitudinem & pondus rei, quæ a me tractatur, Celsitudini V. calcar adhibiturum esse, ut cum benigno responso ex Germania me dimitteret. Quod quia Q[?] factum
main_text.notes: Catchword-like word at foot ("factum") is a continuation of the text. Opening initial "J" is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "Ussi"; read as "Jussi" with uncertainty. Initial letters rendered as printed. Some words in the text are in a Fraktur-like or italic style; no black letter apart from italic names.
